name: Resource Guru
description: Resource Guru is resource scheduling and capacity-planning software for teams that need to coordinate people, equipment, and shared spaces. Organizations use it to manage bookings, availability, leave, projects, clients, utilization, billable time, timesheets, workload, and resource-planning reports.
agentUseSummary: Connect Resource Guru once, then choose which agents can read or manage the connected organization's resource planning under Safe or Dangerous policy.

capabilities.label: Read resource planning
capabilities.description: Use all 60 pinned official read operations for accounts, schedules, bookings, resources, projects, clients, time off, timesheets, reports, and settings.

capabilities.label: Manage resource planning
capabilities.description: Use all 52 pinned official mutations for bookings, people and resources, projects, clients, leave, timesheets, webhooks, and account configuration.

allowed.label: Read Resource Guru
allowed.description: Run one exact selected Resource Guru GET operation from the pinned official API contract.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Resource Guru
approvalRequired.description: Run one exact selected Resource Guru mutation; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All 60 bounded reads run directly; every mutation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All 112 selected and provider-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval; connection ownership, exact routes, bounds, audits, redaction, provider limits, and account authority still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts the selected pinned Resource Guru operations through the authenticated server-side connector.
Railway mounts the selected pinned Resource Guru operations through the authenticated server-side connector.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's Resource Guru OAuth application, exact production callback, Railway client credentials, and a representative connected account are not configured.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a Resource Guru ID, register Relay Console as a confidential OAuth application at app.resourceguruapp.com/developers, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/resource-guru/callback exactly, store RESOURCE_GURU_CLIENT_ID and RESOURCE_GURU_CLIENT_SECRET on Railway, deploy, then verify authorization, identity and account binding, seven-day access-token renewal with refresh-token rotation, bounded reads, Safe approval, Dangerous mutations, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Resource Guru publishes an OpenAPI 3.0.3 REST contract with 112 operations across accounts, bookings, clients, projects, resources, time off, timesheets, webhooks, reports, and settings; Relay pins the complete documented operation set.

Resource Guru documents OAuth 2.0 authorization-code applications, exact HTTPS redirect URIs, confidential client secrets or public-client PKCE, seven-day access tokens, rotating refresh tokens, and the connected-user /v1/me endpoint.
Resource Guru provides a signed-in developer center for registering OAuth applications; Relay still needs its own application ID, secret, callback registration, and representative test authorization.
Resource Guru states that API and webhook integrations are available on all plans without an integration surcharge, while ordinary Resource Guru account ownership and provider limits still apply.
